**Director of Quality**

**Eldridge, IA – Direct Hire**

**Full time – On Site**

Productive Resources (www.productiveresources.com) is seeking a candidate to be part of our engineering team for our customer's facility in Eldridge, IA. As a member of our team, the selected candidate will be a Director of Quality who provides strategic and hands-on leadership for quality operations and is responsible for the planning, organization, direction, coordination, compliance, and control of the Company's Quality Management System. This role leads the Quality team and ensures the effectiveness of quality processes across the organization, including product and process quality, supplier quality, inspection activities, corrective actions, audit readiness, customer quality performance, and compliance with all applicable contractual, regulatory, and government requirements.

The Director of Quality is responsible for developing and leading employees, strengthening accountability, and partnering with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Program Management, and Executive Leadership to prevent defects, drive continuous improvement, and support the safe, compliant, and on-time delivery of mission-critical products. This position oversees departmental personnel and processes, providing coaching, direction, and support to ensure the safe and efficient execution of work while maintaining quality standards, meeting customer requirements, and effectively managing operational costs. Through strong leadership and oversight, the Director of Quality ensures quality objectives are achieved and organizational performance continuously improves.

This is a full-time position that is indefinite in duration with the opportunity of professional growth, and additional opportunities within our organization.

**Duties:**

* Lead, mentor, and develop Quality managers, engineers, inspectors, supplier quality personnel, and other assigned team members.
* Establish and execute a quality strategy aligned with Company goals, customer expectations, contractual requirements, and operational priorities.
* Maintain and continually improve the Quality Management System and ensure processes remain effective, documented, implemented, and audit-ready.
* Lead internal, external, customer, registrar, and government audits; ensure findings are contained, corrected, and closed with effective corrective action.
* Own quality performance metrics and executive reporting, including product conformity, customer complaints, supplier quality, corrective action, scrap, rework, cost of poor quality, first-pass yield, and audit performance.
* Drive disciplined nonconformance control, material review, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action, and verification of effectiveness.
* Partner with Manufacturing and Engineering to improve process capability, inspection planning, product acceptance methods, error prevention, and manufacturability.
* Oversee inspection and test activities, measurement-system controls, calibration coordination, and the integrity and retention of quality records.
* Lead supplier quality strategy, qualification, surveillance, performance review, development, and supplier corrective action.
* Ensure customer-specific, contractual, regulatory, and government quality requirements are identified, flowed down, implemented, and maintained.
* Support first article inspections, source inspections, customer returns, complaint investigations, configuration and change-control activities, and product or process validation as required.
* Build a quality culture focused on prevention, accountability, objective evidence, timely escalation, and continuous improvement.
* Develop departmental staffing, training, succession, budget, and resource plans necessary to support current operations and future growth.
* Collaborate with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Program Management, Sales, Finance, Human Resources, and executive leadership to resolve systemic issues and meet Company objectives.
* Any other duties assigned by Vice President of Operations.
 

 

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Industrial Technology, Operations, or a related field.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible leadership experience managing quality functions and teams within a manufacturing environment.
* Demonstrated experience leading a multi-functional quality organization, including Quality Engineering, Inspection, Supplier Quality, Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA), Internal Audits, and Regulatory/Customer Compliance activities.
* Strong knowledge of Quality Management Systems (QMS), including the development, implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of quality processes and standards.
* Experience with ISO 9001:2015 requirements, including coordinating and conducting internal audits and maintaining audit readiness.
* Proven ability to lead teams, develop talent, drive accountability, and collaborate cross-functionally to achieve quality and operational objectives.
* Strong working knowledge of NADCAP accreditation, its QMS, and quality requirements related to the special processes within Chemical Processing and Non-destructive Testing.
* Experience leading internal, customer, registrar, and government audits and responding effectively to findings.
* Experience with root cause analysis and corrective action methods such as 8D, 5 Why, fishbone analysis, A3, and DMAIC.
* Working knowledge of statistical process control, process capability, measurement systems, control plans, and risk-based quality planning.
* Experience with supplier qualification, supplier performance management, supplier corrective action, and supplier development.
* Familiarity with government contracting and customer quality requirements, including FAR/DFARS and DCMA oversight, is preferred.
* Ability to translate quality data into clear priorities, executive-level metrics, and sustainable improvements.
* Excellent leadership, communication, coaching, conflict-resolution, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Ability to balance strategic planning with direct engagement on the manufacturing floor and timely resolution of customer or production issues.
* Professional certifications such as ASQ Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence, Certified Quality Engineer, or Lean Six Sigma Black Belt are preferred.
* Must have good written and verbal communication skills while being able to motivate and manage reporting personnel, collaboration with peers, and report up to executive leadership as needed.
* Must be able to professionally coach and direct activities of a diverse team while being fair and consistent.
 

 

**Preferred:**

* Master's degree in Engineering, Quality, Operations, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* ISO Auditor Certification, Lean Six Sigma Certification, or other relevant quality management certifications.
* Experience in defense, government contracting, firearms, ammunition, aerospace, weapons systems, or another highly regulated precision manufacturing environment.
* Knowledge of first article inspection, including AS9102.
 

 

**Compensation & Benefits:**

We offer competitive salaries, comprehensive benefits, and excellent growth opportunities.

If you are the right person, if you have the expertise we need, submit your resume now!

card.description:
* Team:Industrial Operations & Product Supply
* Location:Saratoga Springs
* Req ID:R53236
* Contract:Full time
* Work Pattern:Onsite

**The role**
------------

**Build our future together:**

At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. We’re hiring a Sr. Director/Executive Director of Quality for our new highly automated bulk/ drug substance manufacturing plant, supporting 20–30 tech transfers a year alongside commercial delivery responsibility. GMP production will run concurrently with construction and CQV for 3–5 years. This role requires both building and operating.

 
 

This site operates on a foundation of strategy, execution, and rigor. Every function at the site owns a pyramid of metrics derived from annual goal planning that connects the site’s strategic goals to the factory floor, with performance measured back up to leadership to monitor, track, and mitigate against contingencies quantified using SMART goals in days and dollars.

 
 

The Sr. Director/Executive Director of Quality leads all aspects of site Quality Control and Quality Assurance operations including QA Operations, QA Systems, QA Validation, and QC. In this role you’ll lead the site quality system and culture, batch disposition, and inspection readiness. This role owns and manages all regulatory inspections; and represents the site’s conduit for quality metrics, quality system work, and transformational quality strategy to bring Regeneron to best-in-class lean quality operations. They will oversee and preserve our quality independence from operational pressure while partnering closely with site leadership.

 
 

**When & where:**

* Location: Saratoga Springs, New York, United States

* Work model: Monday-Friday, 8am-4:30pm
 

 

**Discover your role:**

* Own the site quality system (both QA &QC) and lead a culture of compliance, accountability, and right-first-time execution

* + QA: ops, systems, and validation owned directly alongside QC as part of a unified site quality organization

* + QC: responsible for delivering utilities, in-process and release testing, performing environmental monitoring, QC laboratory compliance, and method transfer support that enable timely, compliant batch release

* Oversee these functions OpEx and CapEx budget and roadmap

* Serve as the primary party responsible for this function's alignment with the Global Center of Excellence (COE), connecting site execution back to the business-level function

* Ensure this function's metrics flow up and down through the MDI structure, connecting into the site's S&OP, AOP, and long-range planning cycles

* Hold batch disposition authority, ensuring compliance and timely batch release

* Own and manage all regulatory inspections ensuring the site is continuously inspection-ready and leading the site through regulatory agency inspections and customer and corporate audits

* Serve as the site's primary conduit for quality metrics, quality system work, and l quality strategy connecting site execution to enterprise quality’s vision for best-in-class lean quality operations

* Provide governance of laboratory investigations, deviations, and CAPA management across all quality sub-functions

* Lead all aspects of batch record review and disposition support, floor quality presence, and deviation management for manufacturing for Saratoga Site

* Lead all aspects of QMS administration, document control, training compliance, CAPA system administration, and audit readiness for Saratoga Site

* Build and coordinate best-in-class validation programs process, cleaning, and equipment validation grounded in FDA's three-stage process validation lifecycle (Stage 1 Process Design, Stage 2 Process Qualification/PPQ, Stage 3 Continued Process Verification), EU Annex 15, ASTM E2500 risk-based qualification, and ICH Q8–Q11 Quality by Design principles tailored to large-molecule biotech manufacturing, including PPQ support for new suite introduction

* Lead quality readiness for suites entering service, including validation, qualification, and quality system scale-up

* Partner with manufacturing, technical services, technical operations, and supply chain as a core member of the site leadership team

* Own quality's role in the digital and connected plant model, including electronic quality systems, review by exception, and data integrity by design

* Build, coach, and retain a high-performing quality organization; establish high standards for performance management and accountability; perform other duties as required

* Lead a gross margin improvement program and goal for this function, contributing to the site's overall margin performance

* Own and manage the site’s data governance program, including data integrity standards, data ownership and accountability, lifecycle controls, and periodic review, so data is reliable from the floor to leadership reporting

* Own and manage the site’s quality management maturity, including assessing current state against enterprise and industry benchmarks, setting the improvement roadmap, and driving measurable gains in quality system performance

* Own and manage the site’s contamination control strategy, including its design, governance, and day-to-day execution across facility, equipment, process, personnel, and materials, with ongoing trending and review of effectiveness
 

 
 

**This role requires:**

* B.S in Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related technical field

* + Sr. Director: 15+ years in biopharmaceutical quality, large-molecule drug substance operations and/or medical device quality including 7+ years of progressive quality leadership

* + Executive Director: 18+ years in biopharmaceutical quality, large-molecule drug substance operations and/or medical device quality experience including 7+ years of progressive quality leadership

* + Level will be determined based on experience

* Experience with batch disposition and release decision-making in a GMP environment

* Previous people leadership/supervisory experience

Does this sound like you? Apply now to take your first step towards living the Regeneron Way! We are committed to building a workplace with an inclusive culture. Regeneron is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief (or lack thereof), sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, civil status, pregnancy or parental status, age, disability, nationality, citizenship status, ethnic or national origin, membership of the Traveler community, familial status, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. Where required, we will provide reasonable accommodation to applicants with known disabilities or chronic illnesses during the recruitment process, unless such accommodation would impose undue hardship.

Where necessary, we disclose salary ranges for roles in all countries in which we operate. The final offer will be determined within the relevant range based on the country of employment, specific role level, and your skills and experience. In some countries, collective bargaining agreements (CBAs) may apply and influence certain elements of pay or benefits. Regeneron offers a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package which may include, depending on country and role: annual bonuses or other incentive plans, equity awards, pension or retirement benefits, 401(k) company match, health and wellness programs, fitness centers, insurance benefits (e.g. medical, dental, vision, life and disability), paid time off, and family support benefits. For additional information about Regeneron benefits in the U.S., please visit https://careers.regeneron.com/en/working-at-regeneron/total-rewards/. For other locations, additional information will be provided during the recruitment process. If you have any questions, please speak with your recruiter.

 
 

Please be advised that at Regeneron, we believe we do our best work when we are together. For that reason, many roles are required to be performed on‑site. Please speak with your recruiter and hiring manager for more information about on‑site expectations for your role and location.

 
 

As part of the recruitment process, certain background checks may be conducted in accordance with the laws of the country where the position is based. The purpose of such checks is to verify certain information prior to the commencement of employment such as identity, right to work and educational qualifications.

 
 

For jobs in Canada: this posting is for an existing position.

 
 

**Salary Range (annually)**

$207,000.00 - $407,400.00

card.description:
**Head of Site Quality**

**New Jersey, USA | On-site | Dechra Pharmaceuticals**

This is a rare opportunity to shape the quality strategy, expansion and future of a world-class sterile pharmaceutical manufacturing site.

As Head of Site Quality, you will provide strategic leadership across Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Microbiology and Quality Systems for a growing manufacturing operation producing biologic monoclonal antibodies and sterile pharmaceutical products for global markets. You will play a pivotal role in driving quality strategy, regulatory compliance, operational excellence and site expansion.

We're seeking an inspiring quality leader who can combine deep technical expertise with strong commercial awareness, building high-performing teams while maintaining the highest standards of compliance in a complex GMP environment.

**The Opportunity**

You will:

Lead all site quality functions, including QA, QC, Microbiology and Quality Systems.

Own inspection readiness and lead interactions with FDA, USDA and international regulatory authorities.

Provide quality leadership across aseptic manufacturing, sterilisation, lyophilisation and packaging operations.

Drive a culture of continuous improvement, accountability and operational excellence.

Partner with senior stakeholders across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Regulatory Affairs and Technical Operations.

Support site expansion, technology transfer activities and future biologics capabilities.

**What We're Looking For**

You will be an experienced pharmaceutical quality leader with a proven track record in aseptic manufacturing environments and a passion for developing people and building quality cultures.

**Key requirements include:**

Significant technical QA experience within pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical quality.

Significant leadership experience in **aseptic manufacturing** operations.

Deep knowledge of GMP, aseptic processing and contamination control strategies.

Knowledge of isolator fillers would be desirable but not essential.

Experience leading FDA and EU inspections with successful outcomes.

Expertise across quality systems, batch disposition, deviation management and regulatory compliance.

Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.

Degree qualified in Pharmacy, Biological Sciences, Microbiology, Chemistry, Engineering or a related discipline.

card.description:
**Position Summary**

Directs the Infection Prevention (IP) Program within San Benito Health Care District (SBHCD) to ensure compliance with TJC, State and CMS regulations. Works in collaboration with hospital leaders to plan, coordinate, and evaluate IP program, policies and activities. Updates annual IP risk assessment and IP Plan with environmental, programmatic, facility, and/or regulatory changes. Provides expert consultation and education to minimize healthcare-associated infections and transmission among patients, staff, providers, and visitors. In addition, they will oversee the activity of regulatory and accreditation throughout the district. Responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining a system of regulatory and reliability testing for the organization’s products and/or development processes and ensure survey readiness for surveys. Leads the organization’s Quality Assessment and Performance Improvement (QAPI) and patient safety programs across the hospital, skilled nursing facilities, clinics, and ambulatory surgery center. Provides strategic leadership for organization-wide quality improvement, patient safety, performance measurement, and high-reliability initiatives. Promotes a culture of safety, continuous improvement, accountability, and high-quality patient care through data analysis, performance improvement, and collaboration with clinical, medical staff, and operational leaders.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conducts ongoing surveillance for detection of nosocomial infections.
* Systematically collects data for the purpose of identifying and tracking high-risk/volume hospital-acquired infections (HAI) and sources of infection.
* Recommends, monitors, and evaluates effectiveness of appropriate IP interventions.
* Collaborates with the hospital and physician leaders to coordinate the IP program to design & implement strategies and interventions to decrease the impact of nosocomial infections across the continuum of car.
* Analyzes IP surveillance data and ensures communicable diseases and HAI are reported internally and externally (County, State, NHSN-CDC) as required.
* Monitors for breaks in asepsis and potential sources of infections; coordinates effective outbreak detection and resolution.
* Reviews patient medical records and other pertinent clinical data.
* Assures compliance with isolation practices and policies.
* Provides orientation and ongoing education to staff and providers.
* Creates and updates IP Policies to keep information and practices current.
* Oversees the hand hygiene program to minimize transmission of HAI.
* Coordinates the IP Committee to review IP data, plans, and policies within specified timeframes.
* Updates the IP Plan and risk assessment annually.
* Participates with environmental rounds team and presents quarterly IP reports for Safety Committee.
* Promotes employee growth and development through effective use of resources, internally and externally.
* Oversees direct operations, including staff and budget, of the following areas: QAPI / Patient Safety, Accreditation (TJC), Regulatory Compliance (CDPH, CMS).
* Organizes coordinates and attends all hospital, board quality, and Medical Staff committee meetings and participates in all pertinent hospital committee meetings where monitoring functions and activities are performed.
* Ensures compliance with TJC, CDPH & CMS regulations.
* Survey readiness, and Plan of Correction follow up.
* Regulatory reporting & Follow up.
* Oversees regulatory readiness, quality measurement, public reporting, and pay-for-performance programs and initiatives, holding staff and departments accountable for achieving performance goals.
* Establishes measurement and improvement activities, including methods to track implementation of action plans following site surveys and critical events reviews.
* Coordinates and manages Core Measures reporting and other functions.
* Leads the root cause analyses and failure modes and effects analyses and debriefings.
* Promotes a culture of safety, high reliability, patient and staff engagement, and performance excellence.
* Develops, evaluates, and maintains dashboards and performance metrics.
* Implementing, monitoring and updating organization’s compliance plan.
* Monitoring and auditing functions of the compliance plan.
* Develops, implements, evaluates, and maintains the organization-wide QAPI and patient safety programs in alignment with organizational priorities and applicable regulatory and accreditation requirements.
* Leads quality improvement and performance improvement initiatives focused on clinical outcomes, patient safety, efficiency, patient experience, and reliability of care.
* Collects, analyzes, trends, and reports quality and patient safety data to identify opportunities for improvement and evaluate the effectiveness of corrective actions and improvement initiatives.
* Oversees the identification, review, investigation, and analysis of adverse events, near misses, patient safety concerns, and other quality-of-care issues, as appropriate.
* Leads or facilitates Root Cause Analyses (RCA), Failure Modes and Effects Analyses (FMEA), and other structured performance improvement methodologies.
* Develops and maintains quality dashboards, key performance indicators, benchmarks, and other performance measures used to monitor organizational and departmental performance.
* Collaborates with physicians, Medical Staff leadership, nursing leadership, department leaders, and frontline staff to implement evidence-based practices and organization-wide performance improvement initiatives.
* Monitors quality performance across hospital, skilled nursing facility, clinic, and ambulatory surgery center services and works with department leaders to address identified gaps.
* Coordinates and supports applicable quality reporting, including Core Measures, public reporting, regulatory quality measures, and pay-for-performance initiatives.
* Prepares and presents quality, QAPI, and patient safety reports to executive leadership, the Board of Directors, Medical Staff, and applicable quality and patient safety committees.
* Supports Medical Staff quality activities, including peer review processes and ongoing and focused professional practice evaluation (OPPE/FPPE), as applicable.
* Establishes processes to monitor corrective action plans and performance improvement activities resulting from regulatory surveys, quality reviews, adverse event investigations, and identified performance gaps.
* Promotes a culture of safety, high reliability, continuous improvement, transparency, accountability, and patient-centered care throughout the organization.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree(Engineering, Microbiology, Nursing, Public Health, Epidemiology, or other Healthcare related field) required; Master degree in either Microbiology, Nursing, Public Health, Epidemiology, or other Healthcare related field preferred.
* Minimum of 2-5 years’ experience in infection prevention, quality management, and/or regulatory compliance, including nursing, epidemiology public health or related field required.
* Minimum of 5 years of Director level experience.
* Board Certification in Infection Prevention and Control required.
* Experience with emergency management, disaster preparedness and/or hazardous materials management.

**Job Type:** Full-time, Day Shift

**Pay:** $225K-$250K/annually

All job offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, physical exam, drug test, and verification of education qualifications and credentials.

card.description:
Chromalloy is a global engineering & solutions company. We are a leading provider of aftermarket parts, repairs, and solutions that safely & reliably extend the life of aircraft engines and gas turbines. We develop, manufacture and repair critical turbine components for a range of engine platforms. Our solutions support the engines running the aerospace, energy and defense industries around the world.
 
**Video:** What We Do
 
Why work at Chromalloy?
 
Chromalloy employees are proud, passionate problem-solvers who strive to live our values every day. A career with Chromalloy is an opportunity to learn from top industry experts, work with important technologies, and unlock a passion for innovation. Join our team of experts, innovators and problem-solvers delivering world-class solutions for our customers. As a global company, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employees feel represented, heard, and able to bring their best selves to work every day. Be part of something bigger with Chromalloy!
 
Our Total Rewards Program is designed to support you today and in the future.
 

* Comprehensive and flexible benefit options starting on day one, including medical, dental, vision, EAP, wellness incentives, and 401(k) with employer matching.
* Development & progression opportunities for every employee – regular performance conversations, training and development curriculum, and engineering fellowship programs.
* Paid time off, including vacation, sick time, paid holidays, and parental leave—all eligible on your first day of employment!
* Competitive pay, including eligibility for quarterly and annual bonuses, depending on role and site.

Eligibility for individual benefit plans may vary based on employment status.
 
 
Job Summary
 
We're looking for a Sr. Manager, Quality Assurance to lead the site Quality function and support safe, compliant, high-quality aerospace manufacturing and repair operations. This role provides leadership, direction, and coaching to ensure business goals are achieved while maintaining a strong focus on safety, quality, customer service, operational excellence, and employee development.
 
 
The successful candidate will lead the full Quality organization — Quality Engineers, Quality Supervisors, Lab Technicians (Cal & Met Lab), NDT, Compliance, and Inspectors — while directing quality systems, driving regulatory compliance, and fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
 
 
Work That Matters
 
At Chromalloy, your work directly supports aviation safety and reliability. Our teams repair and manufacture critical aerospace components used across the global aviation industry. As a people leader, you'll play a key role in developing talent, improving processes, and delivering results that help keep aircraft flying safely around the world.
 
 
**Location:** San Diego, CA
 
**Travel:** Occasional travel required
 
**Schedule:** On-site
 
 
What You’ll Be Doing
 

* Lead, coach, and develop a multi-level Quality organization including Quality Engineers, Supervisors, Compliance, NDT, Laboratory Operations, and Inspection teams.
* Establish quality objectives, policies, and performance expectations that drive accountability and continuous improvement.
* Own and continually improve the site's Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring compliance with AS9100, FAA, EASA, CAAC, and customer requirements.
* Lead internal audits, corrective action programs, escape management investigations, and root cause analysis efforts.
* Partner with Operations and Engineering to improve product quality, process capability, and operational performance.
* Drive implementation of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and other operational excellence methodologies.
* Lead customer and regulatory interactions, audits, and quality reviews.
* Develop supplier quality strategies and oversee supplier qualification and performance.
* Analyze quality metrics and trends to identify risks, drive improvements, and support data-driven decision-making.
* Provide strategic leadership for new product introduction, process validation, inspection technologies, and continuous improvement initiatives

What We’re Looking For
 

* Bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Mechanical, Industrial Engineering, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* 10+ years of aerospace or industrial gas turbine engineering, manufacturing, repair, or quality leadership experience.
* Demonstrated success leading large teams across multiple organizational levels.
* Strong knowledge of AS9100 and aerospace regulatory requirements, including FAA, EASA, and CAAC.
* Proven experience driving organizational performance, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Expertise in root cause analysis, corrective action systems, and quality management principles.
* Experience leading cross-functional projects within complex manufacturing or MRO environments.
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills

Nice to Have
 

* Advanced degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field
* ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE), Six Sigma Black Belt, or similar certification
* Proven leadership experience in multi-site aerospace manufacturing or MRO operations
* Bilingual English and Spanish proficiency
* Experience implementing advanced inspection technologies, automation, or digital quality systems
* Experience developing and monitoring complex project budgets, resource needs, and timelines

Leadership Expectations and Values
 

* Sets Direction: Aligns people and decisions to Chromalloy’s vision and delivers results through transparency and accountability.
* Business Leadership: Drives enterprise value through sound judgment, cross-functional collaboration, and customer focus.
* Leads with Courage: Communicates openly, addresses challenges directly, and fosters accountability.
* Acts Decisively: Makes informed decisions, empowers others, and drives continuous improvement.
* Builds Talent: Develops diverse, high-performing teams through trust, respect, and inclusion.
* Owns Results: Sets clear expectations, establishes standards, and delivers operational excellence.

This position may require work hours outside of the regularly scheduled hours to meet operational needs. This may include work during evenings, weekends, and/or holidays. Additional work hours are assigned based on business requirements. Non-exempt employees will be paid overtime in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.
 
The salary range for this position reflects a broad spectrum of experience levels. Individual compensation within the range is determined by multiple factors, including relevant experience, education, certifications, job related skills, internal equity, and market conditions. We evaluate each candidate individually to ensure fair and competitive pay decisions.
 
Due to government regulation only US persons (U.S. citizen, U.S. naturalized citizen, U.S. permanent resident, holder of U.S. approved political asylee or refugee status) may be considered for this role.
 
Chromalloy participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.
 
Any offer of employment will also be conditioned upon the successful completion of a background investigation and drug screen in accordance with company policy and applicable federal and state regulations.
 
Chromalloy is an equal opportunity employer - vets/disabled.
 
In the United States, if you need a reasonable accommodation for the online application process due to a disability, please contact: https://www.chromalloy.com/contact-us/

card.description:
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on - 6 Dec 2026 
 

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

**A Day in the Life**
=====================

At Medtronic, you can begin a life-long career of exploration and innovation while helping champion healthcare access and equity for all. You'll lead with purpose, breaking down barriers to innovation in a more connected, compassionate world. We work with a sense of purpose and ownership, knowing there is a human life on the other side of every decision.
 
 
In this enterprise leadership role, the Director, Quality Center of Expertise (COE) – Design Quality will advance Design and Development excellence across Medtronic by shaping strategy, standards, governance, and enterprise capability for Design Quality and product development processes. Supporting every Medtronic Operating Unit and product category, this leader will drive consistency, strengthen Design Control execution, improve organizational capability, and help teams successfully navigate complex product development challenges.
 
 
The ideal candidate brings deep Design Quality and product development expertise, strong technical credibility, and a demonstrated track record of leading through complexity to deliver business, quality, and patient-focused outcomes. This individual will be a trusted enterprise partner who collaborates across Operating Units, Core Quality Services, and executive leadership teams to remove barriers, accelerate progress, and enable innovation while maintaining the highest standards of quality, compliance, and patient safety.
 
 
At Medtronic, we bring bold ideas forward with speed and decisiveness to put patients first in everything we do. In-person collaboration is critical to the success of this enterprise leadership role. This position requires an on-site presence a minimum of four days per week and must be based at one of the Medtronic U.S. campuses listed below. 

**Work Location**

This position will be onsite and based at one of the following Medtronic locations in the contiguous United States:

* Mounds View, MN / Minneapolis, MN (Twin Cities Campus)
* Irvine, CA / Santa Ana, CA (Orange County Campus)
* Lafayette, CO (Colorado Campus)
* Greater Boston Area (Boston, Danvers, or Mansfield, MA)
* North Haven, CT
* Memphis, TN
* Fort Worth, TX
* Jacksonville, FL
* Tempe, AZ

Travel up to 20% is required.

 

As **Director, Quality Center of Expertise (COE) – Design Quality** , you will provide enterprise leadership for Design Quality across Medtronic's global portfolio of medical technologies. You will partner with Operating Unit, Quality, Regulatory, Engineering, Product Development, and executive leaders to strengthen Design and Development practices, improve Design Control effectiveness, and enable successful execution across a diverse range of products and technologies.

You will serve as a highly credible Design Quality leader and trusted advisor, helping teams solve complex product development challenges while driving strategic initiatives that improve quality outcomes, product safety, regulatory readiness, and organizational performance.

Success in this role requires the ability to influence across a highly matrixed organization while maintaining a hands-on approach that removes barriers and accelerates execution. You will lead a small team of experts while driving enterprise-wide impact through collaboration, technical leadership, and capability building.

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:

card.title: Quality Director RN
card.description:
At Oceans Behavioral Hospital Katy, healing is our focus. We are passionate about helping adults and seniors manage the challenges associated with anxiety, depression and other mental health issues. Utilizing proven, innovative and progressive therapies, our qualified professionals strive to promote long-term wellness through a range of inpatient and outpatient psychiatric counseling and treatment options.

The Director, Quality and Patient Safety plans, develops, implements and manages comprehensive and effective systems to monitor and evaluate the quality and appropriateness of patient services and programs in support of the organizational mission and goals. This position will work closely under the supervision of the Hospital CEO, functions as a support person in the coordination and organization of administrative processes in a high quality efficient and cost-effective manner. All duties to be done in accordance with Joint Commission, Federal and State regulations, Oceans’ Mission, policies and procedures and quality standards.

 

**Essential Functions:**

* Works with VP, Quality and Patient Safety implementing organization-wide quality programs at the hospital level.

* Facilitates the hospital Quality Assessment and Performance Improvement (QAPI) committee.

* Prepares an annual evaluation of the hospital QAPI plan, including process and outcomes.

* Oversees hospital-wide performance improvement (PI) projects identified through on-going data driven quality assessment.

* Coordinates the hospital’s data collection procedures and provides on-going support and education to staff regarding QAPI tools and reporting requirements; utilizes data and collaborates with leadership to set priorities and provide guidance in their development of quality improvement work plans.

* Serves as a resource to the medical staff, administrators and other staff including participation in root cause analyses, as indicated, to investigate potentially avoidable sentinel events.

* Completes assignments accurately, in a timely manner and within procedural guidelines.

* Coordinates education for QAPI principles and regulatory standards as indicated. Conducts training for staff.

* Participates in Joint Commission Accreditation process including plan of action tracking and completion.

* Performs other duties and projects as assigned by the facility administrator and corporate office.

**Requirements**

**Education / Experience:**

* Associate degree or RN diploma required.
* Healthcare experience related to clinical leadership and/or quality assessment and performance improvement.
* Behavioral health experience preferred.

**Qualifications / Skills:**

* Demonstrates proficient computer skills with MS office products and electronic QAPI software solutions.
* Ability to create and provide training programs on related quality performance topics.
* Ability to work with minimal supervision and simultaneously manage multiple projects.
* Knowledge of state and federal regulatory requirements, Joint Commission Accreditation.
* CPHQ certification preferred.
* Must successfully complete CPR certification and an Oceans approved behavioral health de-escalation program.

**Work Environment:**

Subject to many interruptions. Occasional pressure due to multiple calls and inquiries. This position can be high paced and stressful; must be able to cope mentally and physically to atmosphere. Work requires spending approximately 90% or more of the time inside a building that offers protection from weather conditions but not necessarily from temperature changes.

card.description:
**Job title:** Director, Engineering - Quality Assurance

**Reports to:** Chief Information Officer

**Division:** Central Services

**Location:** US or Waterloo

**Grade:** 23

**About Priority Commerce:**

Priority Commerce is a leading financial technology company on a mission to deliver a personalized, easy-to-adopt financial toolset that accelerates cash flow and optimizes working capital for businesses. Our vision is to eliminate the barriers to unlocking revenue - empowering businesses to grow faster and operate smarter.

We achieve this through the Priority Commerce Engine, an innovative platform that combines payables, acquiring, and banking and treasury solutions. This unified approach allows businesses to streamline financial operations, reduce unnecessary costs, and uncover new revenue opportunities.

At Priority Commerce, we're driven by results. We expect our people to ***be known for results*** - bringing expertise, momentum, and relentless focus to every challenge, helping our clients and each other thrive.

**About the Role:**

The Director of QA plays a key role in protecting the reliability and integrity of Priority’s commerce platform by owning the strategy, people, and practices that ensure software is tested thoroughly before it reaches our clients. This leader builds and scales a high-performing quality organization,

modernizes test automation, and embeds quality into every stage of the software development lifecycle, from requirements through production release. The position requires deep expertise in QA leadership, test automation, and CI/CD, along with the ability to drive measurable quality outcomes in a regulated payments environment. You’ll collaborate with Engineering, Product, DevOps/SRE, Security, Compliance, and Application Support to reduce production defects and customer-impacting incidents, and to accelerate safe, predictable delivery across Priority’s products.

**Responsibilities:**

* Defines and owns the enterprise QA strategy, roadmap, standards, and quality governance across all engineering teams and products.
* Builds, leads, and develops a high-performing QA organization of managers, QA engineers, and automation (SDET) engineers, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and succession planning.
* Directs the design, implementation, and maintenance of scalable test automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright) covering UI, API, integration, and regression testing.
* Partners with Engineering and DevOps to integrate automated testing and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines, enabling shift-left testing and fast, reliable release cycles.
* Oversees performance, load, and capacity testing, and partners with Security to incorporate security testing (SAST/DAST, vulnerability validation) into the release process.
* Establishes and reports QA metrics and KPIs (e.g., defect escape rate, defect density, automation coverage, test pass rate, mean time to detect/resolve, release quality) to engineering and executive leadership.
* Owns defect management and triage processes, including severity/priority standards, root cause analysis, and closing the loop on production incidents with targeted regression coverage.
* Embeds QA practices within Agile/Scrum teams and the SDLC, ensuring testability, clear acceptance criteria, and test planning from requirements through production.
* Ensures testing practices, test data management, and release evidence support PCI-DSS, SOC 2, and other applicable regulatory and audit requirements.
* Manages QA tooling, test environments, budget, and any outsourced or partner QA resources to deliver quality at scale and at an appropriate cost.
* Collaborates cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, SRE, Application Support, Security, and Compliance to align quality goals with business priorities and customer outcomes.

**What Success Looks Like:**

* Customer-impacting incidents and production defects attributable to escaped defects are measurably and consistently reduced.
* Releases ship on a predictable cadence with automated quality gates in CI/CD, and teams trust the test suite to tell them when something is wrong.
* Automation coverage of critical payment, funding, and user journeys grows steadily, while manual regression effort and cycle time decline.
* Performance and load testing identify capacity and scalability risks before they reach production.
* QA metrics and KPIs are visible, trusted, and used by engineering and executive leadership to make release and investment decisions.
* Audits and customer assessments find well-evidenced testing and change controls with no surprises.
* The QA organization is viewed as a trusted partner that accelerates delivery rather than a bottleneck, with strong talent retention and a clear growth path for team members.

**Candidate Requirements:**

### **Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years of experience in software quality assurance and testing, including 5+ years in QA leadership roles managing managers and/or multiple teams.
* Proven track record of building and scaling QA organizations and establishing QA strategy, standards, and processes across multiple products or teams.
* Hands-on expertise with modern test automation frameworks and tools (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright) and API testing tools (e.g., Postman, REST Assured).
* Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps).
* Experience leading performance/load testing (e.g., JMeter, k6, Gatling, LoadRunner) and partnering on security testing practices.
* Strong working knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies, the SDLC, and defect management tools (e.g., Jira, TestRail, Zephyr, Xray).
* Demonstrated ability to define, track, and report QA metrics and KPIs to drive continuous improvement.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business audiences.

### **Preferred**

* Experience in fintech, payments, banking, or other regulated financial services environments.
* Working awareness of PCI-DSS, SOC 2 Type II, and related compliance requirements as they apply to testing, test data, and change management.
* Experience testing cloud-native and distributed architectures (AWS preferred), microservices, and high-volume transaction systems.
* Experience managing offshore, nearshore, or outsourced QA partners.
* Proficiency in one or more programming languages (e.g., Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, C#) used for test automation.
* Certifications such as ISTQB Advanced/Expert Level, CSTE, or Certified Scrum Master (CSM).

**Work Environment & Culture:**

We believe that performance and experience go hand in hand - *an exceptional employee experience is earned through contribution*. We are a results-driven team, grounded in our core values: ownership, authenticity, service, trust, innovation, and camaraderie.

Our culture is built for those who want to make an impact. We challenge each other to grow, celebrate progress, and support one another through shared goals and real connection. Whether you're building technology, serving clients, or supporting internal teams, you’ll be part of a company that empowers you to perform at your best and be known for results.

**Compensation and Benefits:**

**Compensation range:** $233K-$291K USD, $190K-$257K CAD 
We invest in the whole employee - personally and professionally. Our benefits package is designed to support your well-being, growth, and success - both inside and outside of work.

**Financial Wellness**

* HSA and FSA options
* Financial wellness resources and employee discount programs

**Health & Well-being**

* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Mental health support for employees and dependents through Lyra Health
* Family planning and women’s health benefits through Carrot

card.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Fauna Robotics is building capable, safe, and delightful robots for everyday life. We are hiring a Senior Manager to lead the quality, test engineering, and reliability organization supporting our robots from development through production. 
In this role, you will improve product and manufacturing quality while building the testing capabilities needed to scale. Your organization will support new product introduction through volume production across our facilities, suppliers, and manufacturing partners. 
You will build the team and its engineering leadership, set the technical direction, and establish quality standards and validation processes. You will turn changing product and manufacturing needs into a roadmap that supports higher production volumes and additional sites. 
The ideal candidate is a technically strong engineering leader who has improved quality and reliability for products where hardware and software must work together. They can evaluate test strategies and guide critical supplier, production, and reliability investigations. They grow engineers and leaders, and make clear decisions on scope and priority while product designs and manufacturing processes are changing. 
 
Key job responsibilities 

* Architect the quality, test engineering, and reliability organization. Assess capability gaps, define the staffing and investment plan, and hire and develop the engineering leaders and teams needed to scale.
* Establish supplier and factory quality teams, with Fauna engineers embedded at manufacturing sites. Strengthen and scale the quality system to support new products and increasing production volumes.
* Define and lead the reliability strategy, working with our engineers to improve robot performance and durability.
* Build and scale reliability labs and test infrastructure to support product development and production growth.
* Scale and develop the manufacturing test engineering team, shaping its structure, growing its leaders, and strengthening its capabilities to support new products and increasing production volumes.
* Deploy and qualify production test systems across our facilities and manufacturing partners. Partner with the software and systems team on automation and traceable results, and improve repeatability, cycle time, and failure diagnosis.
* Partner with engineering and operations to embed quality, reliability, and testability into product design and production readiness.
* Establish quality and reliability metrics and use production, test, and field data to guide priorities and drive sustained improvement.

 
About the team 
Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.
 
We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.
 
Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.
 
At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.
 
If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we’re interested in hearing from you

------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering or a related field
* 10+ years in quality, test engineering, or reliability for complex electromechanical products.
* 5+ years managing multidisciplinary engineering teams, with a track record of building organizations and developing engineers and leaders.
* Experience scaling supplier and manufacturing quality through NPI and production ramp, with strong knowledge of quality systems.
* Technical depth in reliability and manufacturing test engineering, with experience scaling test programs and infrastructure for integrated hardware-software products.
* Strong command of statistical analysis and structured problem-solving, with demonstrated success turning engineering data into product and process improvements.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with robotics or autonomous systems.
* Experience leading engineering managers or distributed teams across multiple manufacturing sites.
* Experience working with contract manufacturers and suppliers globally
* Experience with product safety certification or formal quality management standards.

card.title: Director, New Product Development Engineering
card.description:
Bevi is on a mission to transform how beverages are delivered and consumed. Our connected beverage platform eliminates the need for single-use bottles and cans, making it easy, fun, and sustainable to stay hydrated. As the category leader in IoT-enabled beverage technology, we're building a future where Bevi machines are everywhere people live, work, and connect. We've raised over $160M in venture capital, serve thousands of customers across the US, Canada, UK and Ireland, and we've been rapidly growing year over year, saving over 1 billion bottles from waste. In addition to driving hypergrowth with our current product line, Bevi is heavily investing in new product development.
 
 
Bevi is hiring a Director of New Product Development Engineering to lead the team that designs our next generation of beverage machines and takes them into high-volume production. The work spans new platforms, smaller form-factor machines, hot water, flavor cartridges, and consumables, and brings together hardware, software, and beverage science.
 
 
Your top priority is scaling. You'll take Bevi's hardware into much higher-volume, lower-cost manufacturing, working closely with ODM, JDM, and overseas contract manufacturing partners. You'll lead NPD Engineering, Systems Engineering, and Compliance Engineering, and own new products from concept through certification and production launch.
 
 
This role reports to the VP of Engineering, sits on the engineering leadership team, and works across Product, Software, Quality, Supply Chain, Operations, and more. Bevi is still growing fast, so you'll have real room to shape how we build hardware and the team that does it. Expect regular travel to manufacturing partners in Asia.
 
 
What You'll Own
 
 
New Product Development
 
 

* Lead new product programs from concept and prototype through EVT, DVT, PVT, and mass production.
* Own product architecture and make the tradeoff calls on cost, reliability, manufacturability, and schedule, while staying hands-on in design reviews and critical build issues.
* Set cost targets (BOM, tooling, landed cost) early and design to them, with DFM, DFA, and design-for-cost built in from the start.

High-Volume Manufacturing & Working with ODMs
 
 

* Lead Bevi's shift to high-volume, lower-cost manufacturing with ODM, JDM, and overseas contract manufacturing partners.
* Work with partner engineering teams as true collaborators: align on specs, work through design feedback together, and decide where their expertise can speed up our programs.
* Drive NPI and transfer to production, including pilot builds, line validation, and yield ramp, with time on-site during critical builds.

Systems Engineering & Compliance
 
 

* Guide Systems Engineering on requirements, architecture, DFMEA, and design verification across mechanical, electrical, firmware, software, and beverage subsystems.
* Oversee product safety and regulatory certification (UL, NSF, FCC, CE/UKCA, and food-contact requirements) so it supports international growth and stays off the critical path.

Team Leadership & Process
 
 

* Lead and grow a team of NPD, Systems, and Compliance engineers, including managers, aligned to one product roadmap.
* Recruit and develop engineering talent to build an organization that scales with Bevi's product strategy.
* Run a clear product development process, with phase gates and design reviews, that works for both in-house and partner-led programs.
* Champion the use of AI across the team to speed up design, analysis, testing, and documentation.

What We're Looking For
 
 

* 12+ years in hardware product development, including 5+ years leading multi-disciplinary engineering teams that include managers.
* Ability to be in the office 3+ days per week.
* Ability to travel up to 25%, including extended trips to overseas manufacturing partners.
* A track record of scaling electromechanical products into high-volume production (tens of thousands of units or more), ideally in consumer electronics, appliances, or connected devices.
* Hands-on experience partnering with ODMs and overseas contract manufacturers (Asia strongly preferred), from spec through design iterations, NPI, tooling, and yield ramp, including time on the ground with them.
* Strong design-for-cost and DFM/DFA skills, with a record of driving down BOM and landed cost at volume.
* Knowledge of high-volume manufacturing processes such as injection molding, sheet metal, die casting, and automated assembly.
* Experience with systems engineering practices and bringing products through safety and regulatory certification.
* A practical, hands-on approach to using AI tools in engineering work.
* A strong communicator who is credible in a design review, on a factory floor, and in a leadership meeting.
* BS in Mechanical Engineering or a related field. Experience with fluid, thermal, or food and beverage systems is a plus.

At Bevi, We Believe Compensation Is a Powerful Tool To Attract, Retain, And Grow Talent. Our Compensation Philosophy Centers On 5 Principles
 
 

* Market-driven - We anchor pay decisions in real-time market data
* Performance-based - We reward individual impact, not just tenure
* Equitable - We ensure fairness across teams, roles, and demographics
* Growth-focused - We invest in talent that scales with Bevi
* Total Rewards approach - We strategically balance base pay, bonuses, benefits, and equity

The posted compensation range reflects the salary\* for this position. Some roles may be eligible for a commission plan or a bonus incentive. All Bevi employees receive equity in the form of stock options. All full-time employees are invited to participate in our Total Rewards plan, which includes health & medical benefits, flexible spending accounts, flexible PTO, and more. Offers to join Bevi are based on a few criteria, including the scope of the role, the candidate's work experience, targeted skills, internal equity of the team, and external market data.
 
 

* For Sales roles: The posted range reflects base salary plus commission which is the total potential on target earnings (OTE) for the position.

Pay Range
 
 
$195,840—$230,400 USD
 
 
**Benefits**

* Comprehensive medical, dental and vision insurance plans with BlueCross BlueShield, 95% paid by employer
* 401(k) with company match
* Flexible PTO plus 12 company holidays, and additional paid days for sick leave, etc
* Generous fully paid parental leave for both birth parents and non-birth parents
* Fully employer paid disability and life insurances
* Wellness and fitness reimbursements
* Monthly stipends for cell phone use and commuting costs
* Onsite snacks, weekly catered lunch, and (of course) unlimited Bevi ... plus composting and terra-cycling, too
* Happy hours, team-building events, bagel breakfasts, Values awards - and more.

**A note on AI in our hiring process**
: We use AI to help synthesize interview notes and surface themes from feedback, keeping our process consistent as we grow. Every application is reviewed by a member of our team, and interviews may be recorded to support note-taking, just let us know if you'd prefer we don't. We'll also ask how you're learning and experimenting with AI in your work. Growing our AI fluency is something every Bevi team member is committed to and invested in.
 
 
Our commitment to responsible innovation is reflected in our partnership with the Mass AI Coalition, a collaboration that aligns with our dedication to community-driven progress and the future of technology.
 
 
*We're passionate about supporting career growth and would love to be part of your professional journey. We also know that talent comes in many forms. We value individual accomplishments, specialized knowledge, and genuine passion over simply checking boxes on a requirements list. Whether you're a seasoned expert or an emerging talent, we're looking for people who are ready to build what's next. If any of our open positions interest you, we'd encourage you to apply!*
*A member of the Bevi Talent team 'recruiting@bevi.co' will be reaching out about next steps if we would like to move forward.*
**Accommodations**
Bevi is committed to an inclusive hiring process and we aim to provide accommodations for persons with disabilities. If you need any accommodations for the application or throughout the interview process please contact recruiting@bevi.co.

card.description:
**Vice President of Quality**

**Growing Engineering & Advanced Manufacturing Business**

**Connecticut**

An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced Vice President of Quality to join a growing, established engineering and manufacturing business.

This is a key leadership appointment, offering the opportunity to shape and develop the quality function, drive operational excellence and embed a proactive culture of quality across the organisation.

The business is continuing to grow and invest in its manufacturing capabilities, making this an important role in ensuring that quality systems, processes and standards evolve in line with its ambitions.

We are particularly interested in hearing from individuals with a background in precision engineering, aerospace or advanced manufacturing, where quality, technical accuracy and process control are fundamental to business performance.

**The Opportunity**

Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, you will take overall responsibility for the strategic direction and operational delivery of the Quality function.

A key priority will be to move quality beyond a reactive, inspection-led approach, working closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Production and Supply Chain to identify the root causes of issues, implement sustainable corrective actions and prevent recurrence.

You will play a highly visible, cross-functional role, influencing how the business operates and ensuring quality is embedded at every stage of the manufacturing process.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and develop the Quality function, establishing a clear strategy, measurable objectives and a culture of continuous improvement.
* Drive a proactive approach to Quality Assurance, focusing on identifying the underlying causes of process and product issues rather than simply addressing the symptoms.
* Work collaboratively with Engineering, Manufacturing, Production and Supply Chain to improve process capability, product consistency and operational performance.
* Lead root cause analysis, corrective and preventative action (CAPA) and structured problem-solving initiatives.
* Oversee the Quality Management System, ensuring robust processes, compliance and readiness for internal, external and customer audits.
* Develop and monitor quality KPIs, using data and trend analysis to identify opportunities for improvement and drive accountability.
* Take ownership of supplier quality, working with key suppliers to improve standards, resolve issues and strengthen supply chain performance.
* Partner with Engineering on new product introduction, design changes and manufacturing process improvements.
* Develop, coach and lead a capable quality team, building technical expertise and accountability throughout the function.
* Work closely with the senior leadership team to ensure quality initiatives support wider business objectives, customer satisfaction and continued growth.

**The Ideal Candidate**

We are looking for a commercially aware and technically credible Quality leader who can operate strategically while remaining close enough to the manufacturing operation to understand where and why issues occur.

**You will ideally bring:**

* Significant senior-level Quality leadership experience within a precision engineering, aerospace, advanced manufacturing or similarly demanding engineering environment.
* A strong background in Quality Assurance, Quality Management Systems and manufacturing process control.
* Proven experience of leading root cause analysis and driving effective, lasting corrective actions across complex manufacturing processes.
* The ability to work cross-functionally, influencing Engineering, Operations, Production and Supply Chain teams to improve quality performance.
* A good understanding of machining, manufacturing processes, materials and engineering specifications.
* Experience with continuous improvement methodologies, statistical process control and quality performance metrics.
* Experience managing customer and supplier quality, audits and regulatory or industry compliance requirements.
* Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to develop teams and influence at all levels of an organisation.
* A relevant engineering or science degree, alongside substantial Quality Management experience, would be advantageous.

card.description:
Chromalloy is a global engineering & solutions company. We are a leading provider of aftermarket parts, repairs, and solutions that safely & reliably extend the life of aircraft engines and gas turbines. We develop, manufacture and repair critical turbine components for a range of engine platforms. Our solutions support the engines running the aerospace, energy and defense industries around the world.
 
 
**Video**
: What We Do
 
 
**Why work at Chromalloy?**
Chromalloy employees are proud, passionate problem-solvers who strive to live our values every day. A career with Chromalloy is an opportunity to learn from top industry experts, work with important technologies, and unlock a passion for innovation. Join our team of experts, innovators and problem-solvers delivering world-class solutions for our customers. As a global company, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employees feel represented, heard, and able to bring their best selves to work every day. Be part of something bigger with Chromalloy!
 
 
Our
**Total Rewards Program**
is designed to support you today and in the future.
 
 

* Comprehensive and flexible benefit options starting on day one, including medical, dental, vision, EAP, wellness incentives, and 401(k) with employer matching.
* Development & progression opportunities for every employee – regular performance conversations, training and development curriculum, and engineering fellowship programs.
* Paid time off, including vacation, sick time, paid holidays, and parental leave—all eligible on your first day of employment!
* Competitive pay, including eligibility for quarterly and annual bonuses, depending on role and site.

*Eligibility for individual benefit plans may vary based on employment status.*
**Job Summary**
We're looking for a
**Sr. Manager, Quality Assurance**
to lead the site Quality function and support safe, compliant, high-quality aerospace manufacturing and repair operations. This role provides leadership, direction, and coaching to ensure business goals are achieved while maintaining a strong focus on safety, quality, customer service, operational excellence, and employee development.
 
 
The successful candidate will lead the full Quality organization — Quality Engineers, Quality Supervisors, Lab Technicians (Cal & Met Lab), NDT, Compliance, and Inspectors — while directing quality systems, driving regulatory compliance, and fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
 
 
**Work That Matters**
At Chromalloy, your work directly supports
**aviation safety and reliability**
. Our teams repair and manufacture critical aerospace components used across the global aviation industry. As a people leader, you'll play a key role in developing talent, improving processes, and delivering results that help keep aircraft flying safely around the world.
 
 
**Location**
: San Diego, CA
 
 
**Travel**
: Occasional travel required
 
 
**Schedule**
: On-site
 
 
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Lead, coach, and develop a multi-level Quality organization including Quality Engineers, Supervisors, Compliance, NDT, Laboratory Operations, and Inspection teams.
* Establish quality objectives, policies, and performance expectations that drive accountability and continuous improvement.
* Own and continually improve the site's Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring compliance with AS9100, FAA, EASA, CAAC, and customer requirements.
* Lead internal audits, corrective action programs, escape management investigations, and root cause analysis efforts.
* Partner with Operations and Engineering to improve product quality, process capability, and operational performance.
* Drive implementation of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and other operational excellence methodologies.
* Lead customer and regulatory interactions, audits, and quality reviews.
* Develop supplier quality strategies and oversee supplier qualification and performance.
* Analyze quality metrics and trends to identify risks, drive improvements, and support data-driven decision-making.
* Provide strategic leadership for new product introduction, process validation, inspection technologies, and continuous improvement initiatives

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Mechanical, Industrial Engineering, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* 10+ years of aerospace or industrial gas turbine engineering, manufacturing, repair, or quality leadership experience.
* Demonstrated success leading large teams across multiple organizational levels.
* Strong knowledge of AS9100 and aerospace regulatory requirements, including FAA, EASA, and CAAC.
* Proven experience driving organizational performance, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Expertise in root cause analysis, corrective action systems, and quality management principles.
* Experience leading cross-functional projects within complex manufacturing or MRO environments.
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills

**Nice to Have**

* Advanced degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field
* ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE), Six Sigma Black Belt, or similar certification
* Proven leadership experience in multi-site aerospace manufacturing or MRO operations
* Bilingual English and Spanish proficiency
* Experience implementing advanced inspection technologies, automation, or digital quality systems
* Experience developing and monitoring complex project budgets, resource needs, and timelines

**Leadership Expectations and Values**

* Sets Direction: Aligns people and decisions to Chromalloy’s vision and delivers results through transparency and accountability.
* Business Leadership: Drives enterprise value through sound judgment, cross-functional collaboration, and customer focus.
* Leads with Courage: Communicates openly, addresses challenges directly, and fosters accountability.
* Acts Decisively: Makes informed decisions, empowers others, and drives continuous improvement.
* Builds Talent: Develops diverse, high-performing teams through trust, respect, and inclusion.
* Owns Results: Sets clear expectations, establishes standards, and delivers operational excellence.

This position may require work hours outside of the regularly scheduled hours to meet operational needs. This may include work during evenings, weekends, and/or holidays. Additional work hours are assigned based on business requirements. Non-exempt employees will be paid overtime in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.
 
 
The salary range for this position reflects a broad spectrum of experience levels. Individual compensation within the range is determined by multiple factors, including relevant experience, education, certifications, job related skills, internal equity, and market conditions. We evaluate each candidate individually to ensure fair and competitive pay decisions.
 
 
**Due to government regulation only US persons (U.S. citizen, U.S. naturalized citizen, U.S. permanent resident, holder of U.S. approved political asylee or refugee status) may be considered for this role.**
Chromalloy participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.
 
 
Any offer of employment will also be conditioned upon the successful completion of a background investigation and drug screen in accordance with company policy and applicable federal and state regulations.
 
 
Chromalloy is an equal opportunity employer - vets/disabled.
 
 
In the United States, if you need a reasonable accommodation for the online application process due to a disability, please contact: https://www.chromalloy.com/contact-us/

card.description:
We are partnering with a leading global prestige beauty and skincare company to identify a
**Vice President of Quality**
to lead its North American Quality organization.

This is a high-impact executive leadership opportunity for a commercially minded quality professional who can connect quality, regulatory compliance, manufacturing excellence, and business performance within a complex, global organization.

The successful candidate will oversee Quality across North American manufacturing and distribution operations, providing leadership to a network of internal manufacturing operations and external manufacturing partners across multiple continents.

**About The Opportunity**

Reporting into senior global leadership, the Vice President of Quality will lead an organization of approximately 100 professionals, with four Directors reporting directly into the role.

The scope encompasses contract manufacturing quality, factory quality (QA, QC, laboratories, and Quality Management Systems), and quality assurance across North America, while providing technical quality leadership and guidance to teams in Canada and Brazil.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Lead the North American Quality organization:**
 Provide strategic direction and leadership across manufacturing, quality assurance, quality control, laboratories, and quality systems.
* **Act as the business voice of Quality:**
 Partner with commercial, brand, manufacturing, and executive stakeholders to translate quality and regulatory requirements into sound business decisions.
* **Drive regulatory and compliance excellence:**
 Ensure alignment between global quality standards and US regulatory requirements, particularly FDA OTC regulations and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP).
* **Oversee contract manufacturing quality:**
 Provide quality leadership and oversight across a network of approximately 30–40 contract manufacturing partners, including key strategic suppliers.
* **Strengthen organizational capabilities:**
 Develop a technically strong team, promote greater autonomy, build leadership capabilities, and establish succession depth.
* **Partner with manufacturing leadership:**
 Work closely with plant and operational leaders to balance quality expectations with production demands, providing constructive challenge and driving continuous improvement.
* **Lead through influence:**
 Build strong relationships across a global, multicultural, and matrixed organization, including teams and stakeholders outside of the direct reporting structure.
* **Prepare the organization for future growth:**
 Build the organizational structure, capabilities, and relationships necessary to support a potentially broader international Quality remit.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

* Extensive leadership experience in Quality within beauty, personal care, consumer health, or complex consumer goods manufacturing environments.
* Strong hands-on experience with
 **FDA OTC regulations and GMP requirements**
 .
* Proven experience leading large, multi-layered Quality organizations and developing senior leadership teams.
* Experience overseeing contract manufacturers, external manufacturing partners, and complex supplier networks.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing quality, QA, QC, laboratory operations, and Quality Management Systems.
* Commercially oriented leadership approach, with the ability to translate technical and regulatory considerations into practical business decisions.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and operate effectively within global, matrixed organizations.
* Experience balancing quality standards, operational performance, and business priorities.
* Conversational French is considered a strong advantage.
